channel.title: Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio - system-design
channel.description: system-design articles from Khoa Tran Engineering Portfolio.

item.title: Designing a Multi-Service Auth Platform: The Aegis Architecture
item.description: A deep dive into Aegis, a high-performance authorization platform using gRPC microservices, a GraphQL gateway, Kafka audit logging, and OpenTelemetry.

item.title: Designing a Real-Time Fraud Detection Engine with Velocity Rules
item.description: How I built a real-time fraud detection engine using Event Sourcing, CQRS, and velocity rules to automatically freeze malicious accounts in a core banking system.

item.title: Implementing the Saga Pattern for Distributed Money Transfers
item.description: How we built a two-phase distributed transfer between account aggregates using the Saga orchestrator pattern, with automatic compensation and dead-letter recovery.

item.title: Atomic Financial Transactions in a NoSQL World: Building the J-Point Loyalty Engine
item.description: Implementing virtual currency transactions on Firestore with <1% consistency errors, covering atomic operation design and edge case handling.

item.title: Designing a Burst-Traffic Async Job Pipeline: The Jujuja Quest System
item.description: How we redesigned daily quest processing from synchronous handlers to a queue-driven worker pool that handles 1,500 concurrent users during campaign windows.

item.title: Building an Event-Driven Architecture
item.description: A practical blueprint for introducing domain events to untangle a monolith without losing delivery guarantees.

item.title: System Design Trade-offs in Practice
item.description: A structured framework to communicate architecture trade-offs with product, operations, and engineering teams.
